name: get_account_usage
title: Plan usage this month
description:
Usage against the plan for one calendar month in UTC (default: the month in progress, which is partial):
messages sent and received, AI actions, seats and channels, each with its cap, what is left, and whether
that cap is enforced. `definitions` says what each meter counts.

month.description: The calendar month to report, as YYYY-MM (for example 2026-09), interpreted in UTC. Omit it for the month in progress. A future month is refused.
